name: Camp Fatima
description_short: Catholic overnight camp for boys on Upper Suncook Lake in Gilmanton Iron Works, run by the Diocese of Manchester since 1949. Campers live in cabins and spend the day on waterskiing, sailing and other lake sports, archery, climbing, hiking and team games, along with daily prayer and Mass. A co-ed Special Needs Week runs twice a summer.
refund_policy_summary: Registration fees ($250 per two week session, $150 per one week session) and card fees are never refunded. Cancel by February 28 and the rest of the tuition is refunded; from March 1 there are no refunds, and none for late arrival or leaving early. A session can be switched at no cost if there is space. Medical cancellations are reviewed case by case with a doctor's note.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons and free swim in the lake, with staff holding American Red Cross Lifeguard certification.
notes: Two week sessions are $2,500 and one week sessions $1,300, plus a registration fee that counts toward tuition. Sibling discount $100 per session; NH resident and Catholic school or parish discounts by asking the office. Optional laundry ($40) and change weekend trip ($100) for campers staying two or more sessions. Camp is phone free. Ages are not stated except Starter Week (6 to 12) and CIT (16).

special_needs_notes: Special Needs Week at Fatima is co-ed and for campers with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Session one (age 9 and up) has a 3 to 1 camper to staff ratio for campers who walk unassisted and manage basic self care; session two adds 1 to 1 support for limited mobility, wheelchair use, behavior support or nonverbal campers.
